title: LLMs Unplugged: Understand how AI language models work by building one yourself.
description: Educational materials for teaching how AI language models work by building N-gram models from scratch with pen, paper and dice. This deposit is a dated snapshot of the tested lessons: each lesson's slides and presenter guide (with speaker notes) as PDFs, its printables (grid worksheets, pre-trained model booklets, cutouts, ledger sheets), and the prebuilt command-line tool that generates them, alongside the full source. The living version, with every lesson and module and the interactive tools, is at https://www.llmsunplugged.org. A Cybernetic Studio project.
